Ivy (CS): Drafting a concise customer-facing ops snapshot for low-touch pilots. Focus: minimal prefill, client batching defaults, streaming opt-outs, renewal green flags. Need a quick review.

Ivy (CS): Proposed short checklist we hand to customers before go-live:
- Prefill only top-3 user prefixes 10m before demo
- Client batching: 50ms window or 8 messages max
- Streaming: enabled; fallback to single-shot 40 tokens if queue >30
- Capture 1-min live metrics + 24h summary for AE
- Post-demo 3-question micro-survey link

Nora (Solutions): For low-touch customers keep code examples tiny. Example curl for prefill: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -d '{\"tenant_id\":\"acme-lite\",\"prefixes\":[\"billing\"],\"ttl\":600}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill`

Ravi (SRE): Ops notes: warm-pool target 1 GPU, prefill TTL 600s. Alert if kv hit rate <0.5 for >10m. Add snippet: `sum(rate(kv_cache_hits[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_requests[5m])) < 0.5` -> warn. Also advise enabling graceful fallback to smaller model for CPU-bound bursts.

Diego (AE): For renewal signals, can we flag accounts that are "quiet but stable" vs "quiet and failing"? I want exact copy to paste: 
- Quiet & stable: <10 req/day but errors <1% -> watch
- Quiet & failing: <10 req/day and errors >2% -> AE outreach required

Ivy (CS): Adding AE copy under \"handoff\": include 24h P95, kv hit rate, sample session transcript, and survey result.

Nora (Solutions): Tiny Node example for batching I'll add later. Also recommend recommending SDKs use exponential backoff on 429s with jitter.

enablement-bot: Reminder set: \"dry-run enablement for acme-lite\" in 30m.

Ivy (CS): Thanks all. I'll publish one-pager and a 1-paragraph email template for AEs. Ravi, Nora please drop final snippets in the doc by EOD. Diego will draft outreach wording. Any other quick asks?

Ravi (SRE): I'll include PromQL and a short note on autoscale cooldown (60s).

Diego (AE): I'll prepare outreach. Thanks :rocket:
